records.footnote: Data for primary and secondary schools, junior colleges and universities exclude private schools or institutions.

row.rowText: Enrolment In Institute Of Technical Education
row.footnote: Refers to students in full-time courses.
Refers to students in full-time diploma (from 2005) and degree (from 2011) courses offered by LASALLE College of the Arts and Nanyang Academy of Fine Arts.

Refers to students in full-time and part-time polytechnic diploma and advanced diploma courses offered by Singapore Polytechnic, Ngee Ann Polytechnic, Temasek Polytechnic, Nanyang Polytechnic and Republic Polytechnic and National Institute of Early Childhood Development (from 2019).  Students enrolled in Polytechnic Foundation Programme which was introduced in 2013 are excluded.

row.rowText: Enrolment In National Institute Of Education
row.footnote: Refers to students in full-time and part-time diploma, postgraduate diploma and higher degree courses, as well as selected in-service programmes like 'Management and Leadership in Schools' etc.

Refers to full-time and part-time undergraduate and postgraduate students in National University of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore Management University, Singapore Institute of Technology (from 2010), Singapore University of Technology and Design (from 2011), Singapore University of Social Sciences (from 2017), and full-time undergraduates in SIM University (from 2014 to 2016).
